PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Plain-language tips
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.INTRO: Plain language (B1): tips only, nothing is blocked.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.LONG_SENTENCE: This sentence has {{words}} words. Keep it to {{limit}} or fewer: split it in two.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_NL: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we sturen u” instead of “u wordt gestuurd”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.PASSIVE_EN: “{{match}}” is passive. Say who does it, e.g. “we will send” instead of “will be sent”.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.AND_OR: “{{match}}” asks two things at once. Ask one thing per question.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.TWO_QUESTIONS: This asks two questions. Make it two separate questions.
PLAIN_LANGUAGE.JOINED_QUESTIONS: “{{match}} …” starts a second question. Ask it separately.

FORM_LANGUAGE.TITLE: Language
FORM_LANGUAGE.LABEL: Form language
FORM_LANGUAGE.HINT: The language the questions are written in. It tells screen readers and browsers which language to read them in.

REGISTRATION.NOTICE: Not tested against a live environment yet. Try a test system first. What was sent cannot be taken back by deleting a submission here.

SERVICES.TITLE: Case systems
SERVICES.INTRO: Connect the case system that should receive submissions. Each form chooses for itself whether to send, and which answers.
SERVICES.ONLY_ADMINS: Only workspace admins can manage case systems.
SERVICES.TURNED_OFF: Sending to a case system is turned off on this server.
SERVICES.LOAD_ERROR: The case systems could not be loaded.
SERVICES.EMPTY_TEXT: Add one to send a form's submissions to it.
SERVICES.SECRET_SET: Set on {{date}}. It is never shown.
SERVICES.TEST_WARNING: A test sends a small message marked as a test. It creates a record at the case system if that system stores what it receives.
SERVICES.DELETE_TEXT: Forms can no longer send to it. Submissions that were already sent stay where they are.

DIALOG.INTRO: Submissions are sent to this address as JSON, over https.
DIALOG.NAME: Name
DIALOG.NAME_HINT: Only your team sees this name. At most 80 characters.
DIALOG.ADDRESS_HINT: Start with https://. No port, user name or query.
DIALOG.ORGANISATION_HINT: Respondents read this name: “Your answers are also sent to … case system.”
DIALOG.SECRET_HINT: We store it encrypted and never show it again.
DIALOG.SECRET_AGAIN: You changed the address or the sign-in, so enter the secret again.
DIALOG.SECRET_SET_ON: A secret is set since {{date}}. It is never shown.

ERROR.invalid_url: Use a plain https:// address, without a port, user name or query.
ERROR.not_allowed: That address points to a private network. Use a public address.
ERROR.unreachable: That address could not be found. Check the spelling.
ERROR.invalid_auth_name: Check the header name or the user name.
ERROR.invalid_secret: The secret is empty or has characters that are not allowed.
ERROR.secret_required: Enter the secret for this sign-in.
ERROR.name_taken: A case system with this name already exists.
ERROR.service_in_use: A form still sends to this case system. Turn that off first.
ERROR.service_not_found: This case system no longer exists. Reload the page.
ERROR.variables_required: Choose at least one answer to send.
ERROR.unknown_variable: One of the chosen answers is no longer in this form. Reload the page.
ERROR.variable_not_supported: One of the chosen answers cannot be sent yet.
ERROR.invalid_key: Use letters, digits and _ only, and start with a letter or _. Every name must be different.
ERROR.invalid_transform: Only a multiple-choice question that is sent can be sent as a list.
ERROR.invalid_path: Use a path like /cases, without .., ? or #.
ERROR.form_not_collected_here: Only forms made in bettercollected can send to a case system.
ERROR.too_many_variables: You can send at most 200 answers.
ERROR.not_retryable: This submission cannot be sent again right now.
ERROR.registration_off: Sending to a case system is turned off on this server.
ERROR.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
ERROR.not_found: This could not be found. Reload the page.

TEST.ok: The test arrived. The case system accepted it.
TEST.unreachable: The case system could not be reached.
TEST.timeout: The case system did not answer in time.
TEST.tls_error: The secure connection failed. Check the certificate.
TEST.not_allowed: The address points to a private network.
TEST.redirect_refused: The address sends us somewhere else. Use the final address.
TEST.http_4xx: The case system refused the test (HTTP {{status}}). Check the address and the sign-in.
TEST.http_5xx: The case system had an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later.
TEST.secret_unreadable: The stored secret cannot be read. Replace it.
TEST.config_invalid: The settings of this case system are incomplete. Edit and save it.

FORM.TITLE: Send submissions to a case system
FORM.INTRO: Choose where the answers of this form go, and which ones. Only the answers you choose leave this form. Submissions made before you turn this on are not sent.
FORM.LOAD_ERROR: The settings could not be loaded.
FORM.ENABLE: Send submissions to a case system
FORM.NO_SERVICES: There is no case system yet.
FORM.ADD_SERVICE: Add one in the workspace settings
FORM.PATH_HINT: Added to the address of the case system. Leave empty to send to the address itself.
FORM.VARIABLES_HINT: Tick the answers to send. Each one gets a name in the data we send.
FORM.NO_VARIABLES: This form has no answers to send yet.
FORM.KEY_TAKEN: Another answer already uses this name.
FORM.AS_LIST: Send the chosen options as a list
FORM.ALWAYS_SENT: Always sent: a public reference, the form version and the time of the submission.
FORM.DROPPED_one: {{count}} chosen answer is no longer in this form and was left out.
FORM.DROPPED_other: {{count}} chosen answers are no longer in this form and were left out.
FORM.LATER_ONLY: This applies to later submissions only. Earlier submissions are not sent.
FORM.SAVED: Saved. This applies to later submissions.

DELIVERY.TITLE: Sending to a case system
DELIVERY.NONE_FAILED: Every submission has been sent or is waiting to be sent.
DELIVERY.LOAD_ERROR: The deliveries could not be loaded.
DELIVERY.RETRY_STARTED: We will send it again. This can take a minute.

ERROR.unreachable: The case system could not be reached.
ERROR.timeout: The case system did not answer in time.
ERROR.not_allowed: The address points to a private network.
ERROR.redirect_refused: The address sends us somewhere else.
ERROR.http_4xx: The case system refused the submission (HTTP {{status}}).
ERROR.http_5xx: The case system had an error (HTTP {{status}}).
ERROR.too_large: The submission was too large to send.
ERROR.config_invalid: The settings for sending are incomplete.
ERROR.secret_unreadable: The stored secret cannot be read.
ERROR.answers_unreadable: The answers could not be read.
ERROR.disabled: Sending was turned off for this form.
ERROR.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side.

PDF_IMPORT.WAITING_FOR_READER: Waiting for the document reader to become available. The import continues by itself.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_REMOVED: Nothing was added to your forms list: the empty draft form was removed.
PDF_IMPORT.DRAFT_KEPT: Your draft form was kept because it already had changes.

encrypted.MESSAGE: This PDF is protected with a password.
encrypted.NEXT: Remove the password (for example by printing it to a new PDF) and upload it again.

unreadable.MESSAGE: This file could not be read. It may be damaged or not a real PDF or image.
unreadable.NEXT: Open it on your computer and save or print it to a new PDF, then upload that. Or try another file.

too_many_pages.MESSAGE: This document has more pages than one import can take.
too_many_pages.NEXT: Split it into smaller parts, for example one per section, and import each part.

too_large.MESSAGE: This file is too large to import.
too_large.NEXT: Upload a smaller file: reduce the image size, or split the document into parts.

too_complex.MESSAGE: This document holds more content than a form import can handle.
too_complex.NEXT: Try a simpler version, or split the document and import the parts one by one.

timeout.MESSAGE: Reading this document took too long.
timeout.NEXT: Try again. If it happens again, split the document into smaller parts or try another file.

empty.MESSAGE: This file has no pages or no content.
empty.NEXT: Check that you chose the right file and try another one.

unsupported_type.MESSAGE: This kind of file cannot be imported.
unsupported_type.NEXT: Upload a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of the form.

no_questions.MESSAGE: No questions were found in this document.
no_questions.NEXT: Try a clearer scan or photo, or a PDF in which you can select the text. You can also build the form yourself.
no_questions.NEXT_WITHOUT_AI: Only the built-in reader was used, and it cannot read scans or photos. Upload a PDF in which you can select the text, or allow AI reading for this upload if your workspace uses AI.

unavailable.MESSAGE: The document reader is not available right now.
unavailable.NEXT: Try again in a few minutes. If it keeps happening, contact support.

failed.MESSAGE: Something went wrong while importing this document.
failed.NEXT: Try again. If it keeps happening, contact support.

START_ERROR.import_in_progress: Another import is still running in this workspace. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
START_ERROR.daily_limit: This workspace has reached its number of imports for the last 24 hours. Try again later.
START_ERROR.too_large: This file is too large to import. Upload a smaller file or split the document.
START_ERROR.unsupported_type: Choose a PDF, or a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo of a form.
START_ERROR.empty: This file is empty. Choose another file.
START_ERROR.upload_failed: The upload failed. Please try again.

THEME.HEADING: Type and shape
THEME.DATA_FONT_HINT: The submission number and other values respondents may copy or read back.
THEME.WIDE_TITLES_HINT: Sets titles a quarter wider, in Archivo's wide cut.
THEME.RADIUS_HINT: Of fields, answer options and buttons. Any choice but Default also letters the answer options (A, B, C) so they can be chosen with a key.
THEME.BUTTONS_HINT_OUTLINED: The button's edge and text take a colour that reads on the page.
THEME.HIGHLIGHT_HINT: The chosen answer and the notes beside a question. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_HINT: The chosen answer only; the highlight keeps the notes. Where it is too light to read on the page, the text colour is used.
THEME.SELECTION_NONE: Uses the highlight, else the button colour.
THEME.GALLERY_HINT: Every preset meets WCAG AA contrast. Pick one to see it on the form.
THEME.CONTRAST_PASSES: Readable: text reaches 4.5:1 and controls 3:1 (WCAG AA).
THEME.CONTRAST_FAILS_one: One colour pair is hard to read. Fix it before you save or publish this theme.
THEME.CONTRAST_FAILS_other: {{count}} colour pairs are hard to read. Fix them before you save or publish this theme.
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_TEXT: Questions and text on the page
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_ANSWER: Answers in the white input boxes
THEME.CONTRAST_ISSUE_ACTION: Chosen answers, icons and progress on the page
THEME.CONTRAST_IMAGE: Text over an image can't be measured. Preview the form to check it stays readable.
THEME.CONTRAST_SAVE_BLOCKED: This theme can't be saved yet: some colours are hard to read. Use the suggested colours or pick others.
